title: PURSUE Tranche 2 Draws Global Media Coverage — Al Jazeera, Hollywood Reporter Lead International Response
detail: One day after the Department of War's PURSUE Tranche 2 release, international and entertainment media ran major coverage of the 64-file batch. Al Jazeera broadcast a video news segment headlined 'Trump releases new batch of previously classified UFO files,' bringing the US disclosure story to a global audience through one of the world's most-watched Arabic and English news networks. The Hollywood Reporter published 'Pentagon Releases Second Batch of UFO Files: The 5 Best Videos,' curating the most striking footage for a general entertainment audience — notably the transmedium spherical objects near a US submarine, the Iranian UAP formation footage, and the senior intelligence officer's orbs account. The breadth of international and entertainment coverage signals that the PURSUE program is achieving its intended public engagement effect. The Al Jazeera coverage is particularly significant for an institutional disclosure tracker: it reflects that the US government's UAP releases are now a geopolitical-level story being processed by international audiences, not merely a domestic niche. The Interesting Engineering outlet also published a detailed technical analysis of the Tranche 2 materials. The combined Tranche 1 (162 files) and Tranche 2 (64 files) totals 226 official PURSUE files now publicly available at war.gov/UFO.
confidenceReason: Al Jazeera, Hollywood Reporter, and Interesting Engineering articles confirmed from search results. Al Jazeera video segment URL confirmed.

media.caption: Al Jazeera covers PURSUE Tranche 2 — US UAP disclosure now a global geopolitical story
